overview: The Arcane Waterworks maintain Ka Vethan’s water supply through void‑arcane filtration and Luclinite purification.
history: Constructed during the early expansion of Ka Vethan’s civic infrastructure.
Luclinite purification chambers were added to stabilize resonance‑tainted water.
Void‑neutralization tanks were installed after Praesertum decrees on contamination.
Crystal conduits expanded to support the growing city population.
Modern Waterworks serve as both utility hub and arcane engineering center.
hooks: Void‑tainted runoff begins leaking into conduit channels.
An engineering team requests assistance with resonance flow.
A Praesertum inspection triggers emergency protocols.
